title: Optics and optical instruments - Optical transfer function application : Part Intechangeable lenses for 35mm still cameras
clause_1_scope: This part of ISO 9336 specifies a method of testing interchangeable lenses for 35 mm still cameras with a picture format of 24 mm x 36 mm in terms of imaging states aimed at making valid optical transfer function measurements. Special lenses for macrophotography, i.e. those designed and manufactured exclusively for obtaining a magnified image are not covered by this part of ISO 9336.

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
